Deficiency_Finding: 2 of 8 sampled terminated employees had accounts active for 18+ hours post-departure (SLA is 4 hours)
Root_Cause_Analysis_5_Whys: 1. Ticket was created late by HR -> 2. HR rep forgot to tag IT -> 3. IT relied on manual notification email -> 4. No shared automation exists -> 5. Root cause: Disconnected HRIS and Identity Provider processes.
Corrective_Action_Immediate: Immediately manually revoked all active sessions and deprovisioned remaining licenses for the 2 identified users.
Preventive_Action_Systemic: Implemented webhook-driven automated deprovisioning between BambooHR and Okta/Google Workspace to suspend accounts immediately upon employee termination status change.
Verification_Method: Sampled 5 subsequent terminations; all 5 confirmed automated deactivation under 60 seconds.

Deficiency_Finding: 1 High severity CVE on internal bastion host remained unpatched for 42 days (SLA is 30 days)
Root_Cause_Analysis_5_Whys: 1. Bastion host was excluded from automated weekly patch reboot -> 2. Sysadmin feared disrupting active developer sessions -> 3. No maintenance window was scheduled -> 4. Vulnerability ticket lacked an escalation trigger -> 5. Root cause: Incomplete automated patching policy for bastion servers.
Corrective_Action_Immediate: Applied vendor security patch and verified clean scan report within 24 hours of audit notification.
Preventive_Action_Systemic: Created a recurring automated maintenance window with automatic snapshot-and-rollback capabilities; configured Jira alert escalation when CVE age reaches 21 days.
Verification_Method: Re-scanned host with Tenable; verified zero open High/Critical vulnerabilities and confirmed new SLA tracking dashboard.

Deficiency_Finding: 3 developers promoted to engineering managers retained administrative write access to production database clusters.
Root_Cause_Analysis_5_Whys: Manager role change was processed without performing an access recertification delta review; permissions carried over during lateral move (privilege creep).
Corrective_Action_Immediate: Removed production write access for all 3 managers; provisioned read-only audit access where justified.
Preventive_Action_Systemic: Updated JML 'Mover' workflow in HRIS: any title or department change now triggers an automated 'Revoke & Re-approve' access review workflow before new role permissions are granted.
Verification_Method: Audit review of all subsequent role transfers over a 30-day window showed zero residual administrative permissions.

Deficiency_Finding: Data classification labels were not consistently applied to internal technical wiki and Confluence spaces.
Root_Cause_Analysis_5_Whys: Confluence template did not enforce data classification metadata headers; employees assumed default was internal only.
Corrective_Action_Immediate: Applied bulk tagging and updated space permissions to restrict public and third-party guest access.
Preventive_Action_Systemic: Enforced mandatory classification dropdown banner (Public / Internal / Confidential / Restricted) on all newly created documentation templates.
Verification_Method: Audit inspection of 20 newly created Confluence documents.
